entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: A giant of Lorwyn, brother of Kiel and Rosheen Meanderer, killed by Eidren's poison.

entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: Brion's giant brother, who prophesied that Rhys would meet Rosheen.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: Giant vagabond sage and sister of Brion and Kiel who shares prophecies.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: An elf the giants worked with and helped.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Helped Rhys free the giants from nettlevines.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin who renewed the giants' vigor.

entities.name: daen Gryffid
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf leader of a pursuing pack.

entities.name: taercenn Eidren
entities.description: Gilt-Leaf taercenn who killed Brion with moonglove poison.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: Elves who ambushed and pursued Rhys and the giants.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: Faeries whose dream magic shared Rosheen's visions.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Place near which Rhys met the giant brothers during the Festival of Tales.

entities.name: Dauba Ravine
entities.description: Ravine whose bridge the giants tore down.

events.summary: Brion and Kiel help Rhys eliminate a boggart raiding party and agree to leave in exchange for stories for Rosheen.
events.quote: Brion and Kiel helped Rhys to eliminate a boggart raiding party.

events.summary: The Gilt-Leaf ambush Rhys and the giants, striking Brion and Kiel with moonglove-poisoned arrows.
events.quote: the group was ambushed during their talk by the Gilt-Leaf pursuit commando

events.summary: Rhys, Maralen and Ashling free the giants from the nettlevines.
events.quote: This was prevented by Rhys, Maralen , and Ashling

events.summary: The giants tear down the Dauba Ravine bridge and the party finds Rosheen, whose visions are shared.
events.quote: The giants helped to tear down the bridge across the Dauba Ravine

events.summary: Brion devastates the elvish party, but Eidren throws moonglove poison into his throat, killing him.
events.quote: The caustic poison burned Brion's throat and poisoned him at the same time, suffocating him to death.

relations.quote: Brion was also the brother of Rosheen Meanderer
